gaps.description: The landlord said, “I don't remember leaving a TV”; the available account does not establish whether the landlord owns or left the television at the property.

The landlord's “Please sort it” reply followed a TV-only works approval request. The reply did not address the downstairs light, TV ownership, replacement, or disposal; no spending limit or specific disposal instruction was recorded. Authorization for those matters is not established.

The tenant said the TV might as well be discarded if repair was not straightforward and was open to removal, but the combined visit request records no decision about TV disposal. Authorization to dispose of the TV is not established.
